parameters.command: ps aux | grep '/opt/dragen/.*/bin/dragen ' | grep -v grep | wc -l

parameters.jsCode:
// Generate the BCL-Convert script
const data = $('Validate Input').first().json;

// Store payload as base64 to avoid quoting issues
const payloadJson = JSON.stringify(data);
const payloadBase64 = Buffer.from(payloadJson).toString('base64');

const scriptContent = `#!/bin/bash
# Stage 2: BCL-Convert with DRAGEN
# Run ID: ${data.run_id}
# Generated: ${new Date().toISOString()}

set -o pipefail

RUN_ID="${data.run_id}"
INPUT_DIR="${data.fullRunPath}"
OUTPUT_DIR="${data.outputDirectory}"
LOG_FILE="${data.scriptDir}/${data.run_id}_stage2_bclconvert.log"
WEBHOOK_SUCCESS="${data.webhooks.postBclConvert}"
WEBHOOK_ERROR="${data.webhooks.errorHandler}"
DEMUX_STATS_FILE="${data.outputDirectory}/Reports/Demultiplex_Stats.csv"

# Payload stored as base64 to avoid quoting issues
PAYLOAD_BASE64="${payloadBase64}"

# Decode payload
PAYLOAD_BASE=$(echo "$PAYLOAD_BASE64" | base64 -d)

echo "=== BCL-Convert Script Started at $(date) ===" | tee "$LOG_FILE"
echo "Input: $INPUT_DIR" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo "Output: $OUTPUT_DIR" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo "No Lane Splitting: ${data.noLaneSplitting}" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo "" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

# Create output directory
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

# Run DRAGEN BCL-Convert (single line command to avoid escaping issues)
dragen -f --bcl-conversion-only true --bcl-sampleproject-subdirectories true --bcl-input-directory "$INPUT_DIR" --no-lane-splitting ${data.noLaneSplitting} --output-directory "$OUTPUT_DIR" --first-tile-only false --bcl-only-matched-reads true 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

# Capture exit code from dragen (first command in pipe) using PIPESTATUS
EXIT_CODE=\${PIPESTATUS[0]}

echo "" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
echo "=== BCL-Convert Script Finished at $(date) with exit code $EXIT_CODE ===" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"

# Check if Demultiplex_Stats.csv was generated
if [ -f "$DEMUX_STATS_FILE" ]; then
    echo "Demultiplex_Stats.csv found at: $DEMUX_STATS_FILE" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
    echo "BCL-Convert completed successfully, calling success webhook..." | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
    SUCCESS_PAYLOAD=$(echo "$PAYLOAD_BASE" | jq '. + {dragen_success: true}')
    curl -s -X POST "$WEBHOOK_SUCCESS" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$SUCCESS_PAYLOAD" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
    echo "" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
else
    echo "Demultiplex_Stats.csv NOT found at: $DEMUX_STATS_FILE" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
    echo "BCL-Convert failed, calling error webhook..." | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
    ERROR_PAYLOAD=$(echo "$PAYLOAD_BASE" | jq --arg ec "$EXIT_CODE" --arg stage "bclconvert" '. + {error_stage: $stage, exit_code: ($ec|tonumber), error_message: "BCL-Convert failed - Demultiplex_Stats.csv not generated", dragen_success: false}')
    curl -s -X POST "$WEBHOOK_ERROR" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "$ERROR_PAYLOAD" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
    echo "" | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
fi

echo "Webhook called, script complete." | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
`;

// Encode the entire script as base64 for safe transfer
const scriptBase64 = Buffer.from(scriptContent).toString('base64');

return [{
  json: {
    ...data,
    bclConvertScript: scriptContent,
    bclConvertScriptBase64: scriptBase64,
    bclConvertScriptPath: `${data.scriptDir}/${data.run_id}_stage2_bclconvert.sh`
  }
}];
